summary: FFLA lists McLain Mountain in Washington County as a gone site of unknown type; no other source found describes a tower there.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source read describes what remains at the site today

notes_for_editor: Very thin: the only site-specific source is the FFLA list row (name, county, coordinates, type Unknown, status Gone). Searches on McLain Mountain, including Maine Memory and Grand Lake Stream sources, returned no tower record for it. Do not confuse with Washington Bald Mountain (Maine Memory record 19142, a 1918 enclosed wood tower replaced in 1934 by a 70-foot steel tower, in T42 MD BPP) or with the Indian Civilian Conservation Corps tower there; those are different sites. Possible spelling variant McLean Mountain not checked against a source. The story is deliberately short. Our record already matches the FFLA row; no corrections proposed.
